:::{#rem-adaptive-method-history}
#### Early adaptive methods

RMSProp is an early example of an [adaptive method](#def-adaptive-method) [@wikipedia_stochastic_gradient_descent].
AdaGrad, an earlier method, replaces the exponentially weighted average by a plain sum of squared gradients,
$u_j^{(t)} = u_j^{(t-1)} + \paren{g_j^{(t)}}^2$. <!-- check-term-links: allow -->

:::
